label: copy phase: input d while outputting i (late in the copy)
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase, and only when the input is d (93% of activation mass) or i (7%). The main case is a fed-back d while the model outputs i, i.e. the original sequence contained the bigram d i, from recall position 3 onward (recall_idx < 3 almost never fires). The strongest examples are original d i i (input d, output i, next output i), which reach 0.8-1.0 of max. Weaker, lower-precision tails: input d while outputting d or s, and input i while outputting i (original i i). It never fires in the original phase or on the delimiter, or on first occurrences of a token. On dev the predicate gets P=0.82, R=0.61, F1=0.70, mass recall 0.78. Broadening to any copy-phase d keeps 93% of the mass but drops precision to 3%.
